    (ARGS 'FLATSIZE->CHARACTER-CLASS) => (5 . 5)
    Why not just (NIL . 5)?
Because the SEND interpreter like to assume LSUBR format -- it
does make for faster dispatching.  DEFMETHOD* creates method
functions and puts in the *LEXPR declaration.
